messages:
anna: Heads-up — thinking about defaults for per-route insights in Console. Should the UI infer defaults from recent telemetry (traffic shape, model mix) or just use simple global presets? cc @sasha @eric
eric: I'm leaning telemetry-driven defaults. Users get relevant metrics without fiddling. Risk: computation cost and inconsistency across sessions though.
sasha: Telemetry note: we already emit per-route traffic histograms + model breakdowns. We can derive a lightweight fingerprint and cache suggested filters. TTL 24h looks reasonable.
tom: Concern: caching + rollout complexity. If heuristic changes, users might lose expectations. We must never mutate user saved queries — defaults only when no explicit saved view picked. Suggest adding a profile tag in route metadata like `default-profile:v1`.
anna: Agreed — defaults must be non-destructive. UX should make it obvious these are suggestions. Version tag sounds good.
eric: UX idea: subtle banner "Suggested defaults (based on recent traffic) — customize & save" with a small menu: Global | Telemetry suggested | Last used. Include an inline "Save as default" action.
sasha: Implementation sketch: pipeline = compute fingerprint -> rule engine -> suggested_filter_set. Output simple array of filters, e.g. `["model:gpt-4o","latency:>100ms"]`. Cache per-route per-window.
tom: API proposal: `GET /routes/{id}/suggested_view?window=7d` returns `{profile_tag, filters, computed_at, fallback_profiles}`. Fallback_profiles can include cheaper model presets for routing hints.
anna: Rollout plan: behind `console.flag.suggested_defaults`. Start internal beta 5% of orgs, measure key signals: suggested_shown, suggested_accepted, suggested_saved, dismissed.
eric: Also need per-user opt-out + persist org-level preference. Telemetry events: suggested_shown, suggested_clicked_customize, suggested_saved, suggested_dismissed.
sasha: I'll draft the event schema and TTL rules. Privacy: use aggregated stats only; mask low-volume routes (<50 requests / 7d).
tom: I'll add API stub & schema; ensure API returns stable profile_tag so we can A/B and rollback.
anna: Action items: @sasha draft pipeline + event schema; @tom API stub & schema; @eric mock banner + dropdown copy. Sync Thu 11:00.
